instructions.question: What attitude does this Facebook comment on a Kosovo public-health COVID-19 post express: positive, neutral or negative?
instructions.rule: Negative covers any frustration, distrust, sarcasm, mockery, blame or alarm aimed at the institute, the government, politicians or citizens, or about the situation getting worse, even when phrased as a joke, a demand or a long argument. Neutral covers light banter between friends, town-ranking or betting jokes that do not mock the institute, bare name tags, plain questions, number guesses, calm suggestions and personal remarks. Positive covers praise, thanks, blessings, good wishes to tagged people, prayers and relief about good numbers.

neutral.what: Comments without a clear attitude: bare tags, friendly banter, betting or league jokes about towns, number guesses, plain questions, information, calm suggestions.
examples: Prap Prishtina spe lshon kreun e tabeles (Again Prishtina won't give up the top of the table)
Rahime Musliu
Qyteti? (Which city?)
Mu prish bastorja 30+ e pata !! (My bet broke, I had 30+)
neutral.cues: tagged names; haha among friends; lige/tabele (league/table); bast (bet); a ka (is there); qysh (how); sa (how many); numbers without complaint
neutral.not_for: Jokes that mock the institute or claim the numbers are made up, and complaints that the situation is out of control, are negative; wishes to friends are positive.

positive.what: Praise, thanks, blessings, warm wishes, prayers, relief or cheering about recoveries or falling numbers.
examples: Ju lumte per punen suksese! (Well done for the work, success!)
Dati Begu perhajr perhajr (Dati Begu, for good, for good)
So keq sa per fillim (Not bad for a start)
Bravo mitrovica hajde ma gjall te kapum 50shin (Bravo Mitrovica, come on, let's get to 50)
positive.cues: bravo; ju lumte (well done); faleminderit (thank you); perhajr/t'hajrit kofshin (for good); me shnet (in health); amin (amen); zoti na ruajt (God protect us); urime (congratulations); sosht keq (it's not bad); lutem (I pray)
positive.not_for: Sarcastic blessings or praise ('Kerrrk Na kofshi per hajr', 'mire ke tu ece' about the lab) are negative; a hope inside a joke about friends is neutral.

negative.what: Distrust of numbers, accusations of copy-paste or lying, sarcasm at the institute, blaming politicians, scolding citizens, angry demands, alarm or despair about rising cases.
examples: Dje 226 sod 224 mos jeni tja bo copy paste. (Yesterday 226, today 224, aren't you copy-pasting?)
Bajat jenii boo mooo pffff (You've become stale, pfff)
E hupi kontrollen e hupi Ferizaji (Ferizaj lost control)
Fajet i ka Albin Kurti Xhelal Sfeqla edhe Arben Vitia (Albin Kurti, Xhelal Sfeqla and Arben Vitia are to blame)
negative.cues: rren/rrena (lies); copy paste; bajat (stale); si bastore/loto (like bettors/lottery); fajet (blame); turp/marre (shame); budall (fool); hupi kontrollen (lost control); pse ??? (why ???); nanen, mut (swearing)
negative.not_for: Plain questions about where cases are, friendly town-ranking banter and calm advice without blame are neutral.
